summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) containing a news release dated October 9, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual general and special meeting held October 8, 2026. Shareholders voted 188,580,782 shares, or 53.11% of outstanding, approving a seven-person board, electing named directors, reappointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, and approving a continued and restated Shareholder Rights Plan. Director support ranged from 58.75% to 99.78%. This is a routine meeting notice and circular, not a special situation.
